marker: # unit_length and ref_repeats are Table 1 of Onteniente et al. 2003, which gives the repeat unit
# length and the number of units in PAO1 for each locus. ref_size is the product these primers give
# in the PAO1 assembly GCA_000006765.1; it equals the expected PAO1 product of Table 1 at seven loci
# and is one base shorter at ms061, 126 against a published 127. A run on PAO1 returns the published
# unit profile 11-12-5-8-7-12-14-45 with a residual of zero at every locus. No repeat unit sequence
# is stored; the motifs are long and several arrays imperfect, and the paper gives a motif length
# rather than a consensus sequence. ms173 is a large 243 bp unit locus whose product reaches several
# kilobases, so it needs a wide size window and may not amplify from a fragmented assembly.
